tag: 職涯發展顧問徵才公告

level.why: 以分詞構句（Reporting directly to…、those having…）、被動語態、provided that 與關係子句組成長句，並出現 attain、subsidized 等較抽象的字彙；需整合職責、資格、應徵文件與福利四類資訊，干擾項多取自文中出現過的細節，比上週同日略難。

passage:
Harlow Group Seeks Career Development Counselor

Harlow Group, a rapidly expanding logistics firm, is recruiting a career development counselor to join its Human Resources division. Reporting directly to the executive director, the successful candidate will design training pathways, advise employees seeking promotion, and help the company attain its goal of filling most senior positions from within. Applicants should hold a degree in psychology or a related field, and those having at least three years of counseling experience will be given priority.

To apply, please submit a resume, a cover letter explaining why the role would be meaningful to you, and a reference letter written by a former supervisor, which must be sent directly to our office rather than through the applicant. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer flextime, which allows staff to begin work anywhere between seven and ten in the morning, provided that the core hours are observed, as well as subsidized training courses. Applications received before the end of the month will be reviewed first, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews, which are expected to take place in early spring.
zh:
哈洛集團徵求職涯發展顧問

哈洛集團是一家快速擴張的物流公司，目前正在招募一名職涯發展顧問，加入人力資源部門。這位錄取者將直接向執行董事報告，負責設計培訓路徑、輔導有意晉升的員工，並協助公司達成大部分高階職位由內部人員升任的目標。應徵者應具備心理學或相關領域的學位，擁有至少三年諮商經驗者將優先考慮。

申請時，請提交履歷、一封說明這份職務對你有何意義的求職信，以及一封由前主管撰寫的推薦信，該推薦信必須直接寄到我們辦公室，而不是經由應徵者轉交。除了具競爭力的薪資之外，我們也提供彈性工時制，只要遵守核心工作時段，員工可在上午七點到十點之間任選時間開始上班，另外還有補助的培訓課程。本月底前收到的申請將優先審閱，入圍的應徵者將受邀面試，面試預計在初春舉行。

vocab.col: attain a goal / attain a level

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To describe changes to the company's promotion policy
To recruit a new employee for the Human Resources division
To report the results of an internal training program
To invite applicants to attend an interview
why: 錯誤：公告提到協助員工晉升是職務內容，並不是在說明晉升政策的變更。
正解：公告是在徵求一位職涯發展顧問加入人力資源部門。
錯誤：培訓只是這個職位的工作與福利之一，沒有報告任何培訓成果。
錯誤：面試是之後會聯絡入圍者的安排，並不是公告的主要目的。

questions.q: What is required of the reference letter?
opts: It must be written by an executive of the company.
It must describe the applicant's counseling skills.
It must be attached to the application documents.
It must be sent directly to the office by its writer.
why: 錯誤：推薦信要由前主管撰寫，執行董事只是新人的報告對象。
錯誤：文中沒有規定推薦信必須談論諮商技巧。
錯誤：履歷與求職信由應徵者提交，推薦信則不經由應徵者轉交。
正解：推薦信必須直接寄到公司辦公室，而不是經由應徵者。

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as a benefit of the position?
opts: Flexible starting hours within certain limits
A guaranteed promotion after one year
Full reimbursement of all training courses
why: 正解：彈性工時制讓員工可在七點到十點之間開始上班，但須遵守核心時段。
錯誤：文中只說協助員工晉升，沒有保證任何人升遷。
錯誤：文中沒有提到出國的帶薪假。
錯誤：文中說的是補助培訓課程，並非全額報銷。

questions.q: Candidates who have ______ the final round of interviews will be notified by phone.
why: 錯誤：who have 之後需要過去分詞，不能用動名詞 passing。
錯誤：have 後面接原形動詞不構成完成式。
正解：who have passed 是現在完成式，表示「已通過」。
錯誤：to pass 是不定詞，不能接在 have 之後構成完成式。

questions.q: The company offers its employees a wide range of opportunities for professional ______.
why: 錯誤：develop 是動詞，不能放在形容詞 professional 之後當名詞。
正解：professional development 是固定搭配，意為「專業成長、進修」。
錯誤：developed 是過去分詞或形容詞，不能當名詞。
錯誤：developing 當名詞語意不符，與 professional 的搭配也不自然。

questions.q: Applicants are required to submit their documents ______ the online portal rather than by mail.
why: 錯誤：at 不能與 the online portal 搭配表示「透過」。
錯誤：within 表示「在…範圍內」，語意不符。
錯誤：toward 表示「朝向」，不是提交文件的方式。
正解：through 表示透過某個管道，submit through the online portal 即「經由線上入口提交」。
